# Figure 4


## Overview
```{r repeats_overview}
repeats <- read_tsv("./Input_files/Repeats_all_mori_mandarina.tsv") %>% 
  mutate(Class=gsub("RC/", "", Class)) %>%
  mutate(Class=gsub("Ty3-", "", Class)) %>%
  mutate(Class=gsub("sat", "Sat", Class)) %>%  
  mutate(group=gsub("/.+", "", Class)) %>%
  filter(absLen>50) %>%
  filter(group != "Simple_repeat") %>%
  filter(group != "snRNA" & group != "tRNA") %>%
  mutate(group = gsub ("PLE", "Penelope", group)) %>%
  mutate (group = gsub ("Unspecified", "Unknown", group)) %>%
  mutate(group=fct_relevel(as.factor(group) , "Satellite",  "Helitron" , "DNA", "SINE",  "LINE", "Penelope","LTR" ,  "Unknown"))

repeats <- repeats %>%
  mutate (Chromosome=fct_relevel(as.factor(Chromosome), "W","A","Z")) %>%
  mutate(Taxon = ifelse (Species == "p50T", "mori", "mandarina"))

repeats <- merge(repeats, chr, by = c("Taxon", "Chromosome"))  %>%
  mutate(Proportion = absLen*100/Length) 

# repeats %>% ggplot() +
#   geom_bar(aes(x=Taxon, y=Proportion, fill=group), stat="identity") +
#   facet_wrap (~ Chromosome)+
#   ylab("Percent of Chromosome ") + xlab ("") + theme_cowplot(12) +
#   theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
#   theme (axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust =0)) +
#   scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
#   theme (axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"))

overview <- repeats %>% ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x=Taxon, y=Proportion, fill=group), stat="identity") + 
  facet_wrap (~ Chromosome)+
  ylab("Chromosome %") + xlab ("") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  theme (axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust =0)) +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme (axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"))

plot(overview)
```

# Landscapes

## Original Martina Plots
``` {r landscape, eval = T}
div <- read_delim ("./Input_files/Assemblies_landscape.tsv") %>%
  mutate (Chromosome = fct_relevel(as.factor(Chromosome), "W", "A", "Z")) %>%
  mutate(Group=fct_relevel(as.factor(Group) , "Satellite",  "Helitron" , "DNA", "SINE",  "LINE", "Penelope","LTR" ,  "Unknown"))


# div %>% filter(Taxon == "mori") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
#   geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, size = 0.1) + 
#   facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
#   ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura substitution level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
#   theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
#   scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
#   theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))

mori <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mori") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, size = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  xlim (0,60)

# div %>% filter(Taxon == "mandarina") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
#   geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, size = 0.1) + 
#   facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
#   ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
#   theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
#   scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
#   theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))

mandarina <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mandarina") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), 
                  color="white", 
                  binwidth = 1, 
                  size = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  xlim (0,60)

#plot(mori)
#plot(mandarina)

plot_grid(mori, mandarina)
```

Martina's plots had a few issues.  One is just software versioning, where she used `size` the contemporary command is `linewidth`, at least for my mac.

But I think this code may also by cutting the lowest bin, as explained in the `repeats` code document. We can modify the way the Xlim is specified to confirm this.


## Martina xlim-corrected

```{r}


mori <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mori") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, linewidth = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 60))

mandarina <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mandarina") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), 
                  color="white", 
                  binwidth = 1, 
                  linewidth = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 60))

#plot(mori)
#plot(mandarina)

plot_grid(mori, mandarina)
```


## Revised by JRW


Here I've tweaked the plots, explicitly setting bin boundaries on integer values and removing legends, which are redundant in the final combined plot.

``` {r landscape updated}
div <- read_delim ("./Input_files/Assemblies_landscape.tsv") %>%
  mutate (Chromosome = fct_relevel(as.factor(Chromosome), "W", "A", "Z")) %>%
  mutate(Group=fct_relevel(as.factor(Group) , "Satellite",  "Helitron" , "DNA", "SINE",  "LINE", "Penelope","LTR" ,  "Unknown"))

xMax <- 50

mori <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mori") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), 
                  binwidth = 1,
                  boundary = 0,
                  closed = "left",
                  color="white", 
                  linewidth = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xMax))


mandarina <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mandarina") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), 
                  binwidth = 1,
                  boundary = 0,
                  closed = "left",
                  color="white", 
                  linewidth = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xMax))

#plot(mori)
#plot(mandarina)
plot_grid(mori, mandarina)
```

## Figure 6

```{r upset_plots}
upset_df <- repeats %>% filter(Chromosome == "A") %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "Repeat", values_from = "absLen", names_from = "Taxon", values_fill = 0)

a_upset <- upset(upset_df, intersect = c("mandarina", "mori"), name = "Autosomal Repeats", set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))))

upset_df <- repeats %>% filter(Chromosome == "W") %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "Repeat", values_from = "absLen", names_from = "Taxon", values_fill = 0)

w_upset <- upset(upset_df, intersect = c("mandarina", "mori"), name = "W Chromosome Repeats", set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))
    ))

upset_df <- repeats %>% filter(Chromosome == "Z") %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "Repeat", values_from = "absLen", names_from = "Taxon", values_fill = 0)

z_upset <- upset(upset_df, intersect = c("mandarina", "mori"), name = "Z Chromsome Repeats", set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))
    ))


tmp <- aggregate(repeats$absLen, by=list(repeats$Taxon, repeats$Repeat), sum)
colnames(tmp) <- c("Taxon", "Repeat", "absLen")
upset_df <- tmp  %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "Repeat", values_from = "absLen", names_from = "Taxon", values_fill = 0)

all_upset <- upset(upset_df, intersect = c("mandarina", "mori"), name = "Whole Genome Repeats", set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))
    ))

```

